channel.title: LocalConvert Blog
channel.description: Guides to file formats, compression and privacy on iPhone.

item.title: HEIC vs JPG: which photo format should you use on iPhone?
item.description: HEIC photos are half the size of JPGs, but not everything can open them. Here's when to keep HEIC, when to switch to JPG, and how to convert in seconds.

item.title: How to compress a video on iPhone without losing quality
item.description: Video too big to send? Learn how bitrate, resolution and codec affect file size, and how to shrink iPhone videos by 50–90% while keeping them sharp.

item.title: MOV vs MP4: what's the difference, and which should you use?
item.description: iPhones record MOV, the rest of the world prefers MP4. Learn how the two containers differ, why conversion is often lossless, and when it matters.

item.title: WebP, AVIF and JPEG XL explained: the modern image formats
item.description: Why websites serve WebP and AVIF, what JPEG XL promises, and how to convert these modern formats to JPG or PNG when an app won't open them.

item.title: How to make a PDF from photos on iPhone (4 ways)
item.description: Turn receipts, IDs, homework or scans into one tidy PDF on iPhone — built-in tricks plus a faster way with page order, page size and compression.

item.title: How to remove location data from photos before you share them
item.description: Every iPhone photo can reveal exactly where it was taken. Learn what's hidden in photo metadata and how to strip GPS location before posting or sending.

item.title: Why you should stop uploading files to online converters
item.description: Online converters get a copy of every passport, contract and family photo you upload. What happens to your files — and the safer, on-device alternative.

item.title: How to make a custom iPhone ringtone from any song or video
item.description: Create an iPhone ringtone from a song, voice memo or video: trim the perfect section, export M4R, and set it as your ringtone — step by step.
